description: Generate and privately save front artwork for an owned postcard email, including emails without attachments. Only after the human explicitly agrees to share the supplied editable email excerpt (message, max 1200 characters) and optional style instructions (max 300) with the image service, pass confirmed:true and a unique UUID requestId. Requires production workspace authentication and OAuth mcp:read/mcp:write. Saved artwork:generate rules prepare verified matching emails during intake, including approval mode; this tool is for explicitly requested generation or regeneration during review. Limit 10 attempts per workspace per hour; retry an interrupted request with the same requestId to recover its saved result. Pass postcardType to match the chosen rule, or omit it to use the email snapshot. Artwork is bound to its size; changing size requires a new generation and requestId. Returns artwork.id and postcardType; use attachment:generated and that artworkId in preview_email_postcard and quote_email_postcard. Existing active checkouts must be revised first; paid/pending orders cannot be changed. No postage purchase or mailing.
name: generate_email_postcard_artwork

outputSchema.description: Read operation first for financial/mail state and recovery. Optional service fields are absent on failure. Unknown is not zero or permission to retry. Legacy service fields remain available.

amountCents.description: USD cents. Null means not applicable or not known; never interpret null as zero.

title: Generate Email Postcard Artwork
